_about: Armored SSHSIGs recorded 2026-11-19 by levain's sign-failure evidence (levain#153). Signatures are public data; no message is stored. 'empty' carries an ECDSA blob of two zero-length integers: two records, made at 08:44 ET at a terminal and 02:09 ET with nobody there, produced these very same bytes (an empty signature carries nothing that differs), so one is kept. 'good' is the 11-18 diagnostic signature from a real Touch ID sign (72-byte blob).
